g.text: SOF Linux Driver IPC Architecture: IPC3 vs IPC4 & Transaction Lifecycle
Dual Protocol Architecture (Fixed Envelope Mailbox vs 64-bit Bitpacked Registers) and Unified Driver Execution Loop
IPC3 Protocol Subsystem: Classic Fixed Header & SRAM Mailboxes
• H2D Doorbell: Writes payload, asserts bit
• DSP IRQ: Clears H2D bit on command receipt
• D2H Doorbell: DSP asserts bit for reply/notify
• Host ISR: Acknowledges D2H, reads Outbox
IPC4 Protocol Subsystem: 64-Bit Bitpacked Registers & Direct Gateways
• Global vs Module Scope: Direct targeting
Payloads > 4 KB stream via Host DMA
Unified Linux Driver IPC Transaction Engine (sound/soc/sof/ipc.c) Execution Flow & Timeout Recovery
